description: All BF16/F16/F32 variants are in unquantized quality class 1 with OPERATIONAL subpriority BF16 > F16 > F32. Numeric fidelity still depends on original checkpoint dtype. Quantized formats rank lower. This does not claim cross-model model quality rankings.

quality_policy.numeric_fidelity_warning: F32 needs about twice BF16 storage; F32 Tensor Core acceleration is implementation-dependent; if upcast from BF16, no information restored
F16 supports less exponent range than BF16; overflow/underflow risk depends on weights and compute
F32 needs about twice BF16 storage; F32 Tensor Core acceleration is implementation-dependent; if upcast from BF16, no information restored

notes: f16 is a valid lowercase GGUF filename quantization when published; e.g. Llama 3.2 1B f16 ~2.48GB. F16 is not present in bartowski/gemma-2-9b-it-GGUF and Gemma 2 9B full F16 is ~18.5GB in other repositories.
Phase 05 selects highest heuristic quality with complete GGUF file bytes no greater than free VRAM reported by NVIDIA; zero VRAM reserve.
Runtime allocations, KV cache, buffer overhead, failures/OOM and actual model residency belong to isolated post-selection calibration.
Full GGUF disk bytes are only a proxy for weight residency and cannot certify actual GPU loadability.
Discovery does not register, pin, download, or accept the model's license; quality priority remains unmeasured.
The policy is shared across registered models, but discovery is per exact selected model AND selected Hugging Face repo, not an all-model global inventory.

Supported GGUF floating-format labels (case sensitive source filenames) are F32, F16, BF16, f32, f16 and bf16; actual GGUF tensor types and conversion provenance must be verified before claiming no quality loss.

F16 and BF16 are two different 16-bit floating representations; neither is universally superior to the other. Prefer original trained/checkpoint dtype. F32 converted from BF16 cannot restore truncated precision.
Minimum profiling context requested on pinned llama.cpp is 256, and extensions are multiples of 256. Existing 128-request load evidence remains historical and must not be relabeled.
selection_rule: GGUF file size in exact bytes <= current reported free GPU memory in MiB * 1048576; no VRAM reserve and no runtime/KV/compute overhead at this step. Not a guarantee of loadability.

float_formats_info.note: There is no GGUF BF32 storage tensor type in pinned ggml. NVIDIA TF32 is a compute mode using F32 storage, not a BF16 substitute.
